add_block.new_heading: What a date night package in Dubai includes
new_paragraphs: A date night package includes everything needed to turn your home into a private restaurant for one evening: a menu, a chef, and full service from setup to cleanup. Working with a single date night caterer, instead of booking a restaurant, means the whole night is built around the two of you. Your booking covers a collaborative menu designed to your tastes and dietary needs, all grocery sourcing and prep, a private chef who cooks course by course in your kitchen, plating and table service through the meal, and a full clean-down so you wake to a tidy space. Optional extras like romantic styling, a wine-pairing brief and a dessert finale layer on top. It is a genuine home catering service, not a drop-off: the food is cooked fresh in front of you, timed so each course lands warm and unhurried.

add_block.new_heading: Date night packages for anniversaries, proposals and celebrations
new_paragraphs: A date night package suits any occasion where you want two people, one table and zero logistics: anniversaries, first dates worth the effort, reunions and quiet celebrations at home. It scales gently to a small engagement party for a handful of guests, a milestone anniversary, or a corporate "thank you" evening where a company treats a couple to a chef-cooked night in. Many bookings are proposals, with the chef holding the pacing while you handle the moment, so we plan those in tight coordination and the timing lands right. Because these are private events in your own space, there is room for personal touches a restaurant cannot offer: the song playing as the starter arrives, the dish from your first trip together, the surprise dessert carrying a message. Whatever the reason, the format stays the same: one caterer, one chef, a night that is entirely yours.

add_block.new_heading: Date night package menu and options
new_paragraphs: Your date night menu is designed around your tastes, not a fixed restaurant list, so you choose the cuisine, the courses and the mood. Popular routes are a Mediterranean or modern-European tasting sequence, a French classic done properly, a Levantine mezze-to-grill journey, or a seafood-led evening. A typical package runs three to five plated courses: a canapé or amuse to open, a starter, a main, and a dessert built for two. The best date night menus balance a little theatre with genuinely good food, so the chef will often finish a course at the table. Dietary needs are standard here, not special requests: vegetarian, vegan, halal, pescatarian and allergen-aware menus are all catered without fuss. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event. Tell us the flavours you both love, the ones to avoid, and any ingredient that carries a memory, and the chef writes the menu around it.

new_paragraphs: The logistics are the chef's job, not yours, and that is the point of a package. On the night, the chef arrives with equipment, ingredients and enough time to set up quietly before you sit down. If you want the evening styled, we can arrange candlelit table settings, a flower touch and considered lighting so the room feels like an occasion instead of a weeknight. Kitchen requirements are small: a working hob or oven and a little counter space is enough, whether you are in a Marina apartment, a Palm villa or a hotel residence. Service runs at your pace, so there is no rush between courses, and afterwards the chef clears, washes and resets the kitchen. You are left with a clean home and no sign of the work behind the meal, only a table for two that felt easy.

add_block.new_heading: How much does a date night package cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: A date night package starts from AED 1,200 for a plated dinner for two, and the final price moves with your menu, course count and service level. That opening figure covers a multi-course dinner, the chef, service and cleanup for two people; more elaborate luxury menus, premium ingredients like lobster or wagyu, or added styling raise it from there. It sits alongside our wider package tiers of AED 1,200, 2,400, 3,600, 4,500 and 5,500, plus a dedicated tasting menu experience from AED 1,400 if you want a longer, chef-led sequence. Set against a fine-dining restaurant for two in Dubai, a private chef at home is genuinely affordable for what you get: the whole venue, the chef's full attention, and total privacy. For a full breakdown see our prices and catering price guide , or send your details for an itemised cost.

People searching for a cheap date night package in Dubai deserve a straight answer, so here it is. AED 1,200 is the price of the table, not the price per head — two people share it, which is the single most misread thing about this product. There is no tier below it, because a chef's evening costs what a chef's evening costs: the shopping, the prep, the hours at your hob and the clean kitchen afterwards. Two levers do move the number. Fewer courses is one — three plates land inside the base package where five push past it. Menu writing is the other: a chef building around seasonal produce, a whole fish or a slow cut will feed you better for less than one building around lobster and wagyu. If the budget will not stretch this month, a romantic dinner at a shorter format is the honest alternative, and we would say so instead of selling you a thinner version of this one.

new_paragraphs: How much does date night cost in Dubai?
It's AED 1,200 — confirmed to your event. Send your details for an exact quote.
What's included?
Menu design, a vetted chef, service and setup, and cleanup where relevant are all included in the package price.
How do I book?
Tell us your date, guest count and venue; we send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Is a date night package cheaper than a restaurant in Dubai?

For two people it is comparable — a private chef-cooked dinner at home from AED 1,200 sits close to fine dining for two, but you keep the whole evening private, with no booking, dress code or drive home.
Can you cook a date night dinner in my apartment?

Yes — the chefs we work with cook in apartments, villas and hotel residences across Dubai. We only need a working hob or oven and a little counter space; the chef brings everything else and leaves the kitchen clean.
Can the menu handle dietary needs or allergies?

Yes — vegetarian, vegan, halal, pescatarian and allergen-aware date night menus are all standard. Tell us at booking and the chef designs the menu around it. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
How far in advance should I book date night in Dubai?
Three to five days is comfortable for most dates. Anniversaries, Valentine's Day and weekend evenings book out faster, so earlier is safer; we take last-minute requests when a chef is free.
For date night package catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
